reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Initial product progress curves, enzyme-loading checks and substrate-series kinetics.

checks.reason: Product addition has a role, but background/no-enzyme and positive detector/procedural controls are absent from the prospective check.
No proposal to consult previous Methods or a validated protocol and check transfer before the validation experiment.
Progress-curve R-squared and depletion do not calibrate signal against known product or test detector recovery/linearity with a failed-calibration action.
Rate units and substrate-depletion accounting are given, but the quantitative endpoint lacks a rule for weak, saturated or missing detector readings.
No operational independent chemical-product/readout validation is given; enzyme-load and time-window checks share the same detector and cannot independently exclude its artifacts.
Proportionality is declared sufficient to establish the initial-rate regime and absence of artifacts; linear detector bias can preserve proportionality. This is an invalid assay decision rule.

checks.quote: a competitive inhibitor that doubles Km,app and an uncompetitive inhibitor that halves both Vmax,app and Km,app could yield the same fractional decrease
checks.reason: Three distinct errors: at the specified 10 micromolar those examples yield 18 and 22.5 nmol/min, not the same decrease; uncompetitive Lineweaver-Burk slope is unchanged, contrary to the claim that slope and intercept both change; a fixed nonsaturating cosubstrate can give apparent Michaelis-Menten parameters, so saturation is not the only valid condition.
